t: Self-adhesive PVC foam draught seal in white for use in doors and windows. Helps insulate and reduce draughts from entering the home. Can also be used for furniture, electrical cabinets, speakers, toys, handicrafts, sports equipment, vents, air conditioners, plumbing, and hvac. Easy to customize and cut to size with scissors or blade, and bends to conform to any shape.
b: Durable With Good Product Memory After Compression
